title: 013 转眼掌珠成贱婢014 施法留声钓海客
content_zh:
：长眉真人的镇压灵符破碎以后，包裹着洞窟的结界瞬间崩溃消失。
管明晦原来总感觉心神上压着一座沉甸甸的大山，如今大山灰飞烟灭，整个人浑身轻松。
如果不是火云链锁着，他现在高低飞出去，在天地之间纵横一番！
杨鲤还以为自己毁了管明晦的“九阳神符”
，期待着妖尸修不成玄阴内丹。
他听见下方黑暗通道里涌上来的地风中，隐约有人声，像是笑声，又像骂声。
“妖尸这么快就被惊动了？这会应该在暴跳如雷吧。”
杨鲤很想看看妖尸现在的愤怒样子。
但他还是忍住了，施法向下，准备回到仙府里，然后就此离开，回南海去。
突然间，黑洞洞的地风之中涌上来大量的黑眚丝。
“不好！
妖尸醒过来，要杀自己泄愤！”
杨鲤奋力挥舞宝剑，劈砍护身。
他的宝剑品质不凡，黑眚丝裹在阴风中蜂拥喷射而至，被他仙剑扫过，都如割韭菜般寸寸断裂。
黑眚丝散作缕缕黑烟，却十分粘稠，聚而不散，围绕在杨鲤身边。
杨鲤快速往仙府洞口逃去，眼看到了分岔拐弯的地方，黑暗中猛然传来几声兽吼，环身的黑眚煞气中竟然凝出一条吹蚺。
那吹蚺有人手臂粗细，张开怪吻，居高临下，对着他喷出大量黑眚丝。
杨鲤挥剑护头，去砍吹蚺，两个脚踝突然被山魈的两个手臂抓住，向下拖拽。
他上下不能兼顾，勉强挽了个剑花，将吹蚺逼退，再去砍山魈。
冷不防吹蚺的身子从旁边的黑暗中抖出来，急速攀上他的身体将他缠住，再张开巨口，从头到脚把他吞进了肚子里，合身收缩成一团，再轰然炸裂开来。

黑气翻涌，吹蚺和山魈全部消失，杨鲤已经陷入了昏迷之中。
呼呼的风声里，只剩下两根黑眚丝，一根缠住杨鲤，一根缠住那把仙剑，向下拖拽，一路扯到床前。
管明晦脸上压抑不住地高兴，把昏死的杨鲤丢到角落里，单将那口剑摄过来。
这剑确实不错，比上不足比下有余，跟蜀山里的顶级飞剑差了一截，无法砍断火云链，但也算难得了。
管明晦准备把它送到地肺中去，用黑眚浸泡，地煞打磨，再日日隔空设法祭炼。
最终，将它炼成玄阴教的招牌——黑煞剑。
没了长眉真人的灵符镇压，他的黑眚丝可以延伸到百里之外，还能轻松透出地表，直接汲取月光！
只要他愿意，可以让方圆百里的山峰谷壑之中，都长满“黑眚丝”
，像水草一样在深夜里摇摆……
杨鲤醒来以后，刚开始还没搞清楚发生了什么，以为自己破坏了九阳神符，使妖尸炼丹失败。
那时候，他还有点高兴，自己就算就此死了，至少也能迟滞妖尸的修行。
可是后面越看越不对劲，妖尸每天乐呵呵的，既没有悲伤愤怒，也没有暴跳如雷，更没有杀他。
反而，对他的态度相当好，还往他丹田里面注入了一股天之玄阴真炁，传授他一门功法，教如何将丹田里面的黑眚煞气炼化：
“你接连帮我办成了两件大事，这是奖励你的。
content_en:
: After Master Changmei’s suppression talisman was shattered, the barrier surrounding the cave instantly collapsed and disappeared.
Guan Minghui used to feel like there was a heavy mountain weighing on his mind. Now the mountain was reduced to ashes and he felt relaxed all over.
If it weren't for the chain of fire clouds, he would be flying high and low now, flying freely between heaven and earth!
Yang Li thought he had destroyed Guan Minghui's "Nine Yang Talisman"
, looking forward to the demon corpse failing to cultivate the Xuanyin inner elixir.
He heard faint human voices, like laughter and curses, in the ground wind that surged up in the dark passage below.
"The demon corpse was alerted so quickly? It must be furious at this moment."
Yang Li really wanted to see how angry the demon corpse looked now.
But he still held back, cast his spell downwards, and prepared to return to the Immortal Mansion, then leave and return to the South China Sea.
Suddenly, a large number of black silk threads surged up in the dark ground wind.
"Not good!
The demon corpse wakes up and wants to kill himself to vent his anger! "
Yang Li waved his sword vigorously, slashing and protecting himself.
His sword was of extraordinary quality. The black silk threads were wrapped in the dark wind and swarmed in. When his sword swept them, they broke like leeks.
The black silk threads scattered like wisps of black smoke, but were very sticky and gathered around Yang Li.
Yang Li quickly ran away to the entrance of the Immortal Mansion, and when he saw the bifurcation and turning point, several beast roars suddenly came from the darkness, and a blowing anaconda condensed out of the black evil aura surrounding him.
The anaconda was as thick as a man's arm, opened a strange kiss, looked down from a high position, and sprayed a large amount of black silk at him.
Yang Li swung his sword to protect his head and went to chop down the anaconda. Suddenly, his ankles were grabbed by the mandrill's arms and dragged downwards.
He couldn't take care of both the top and bottom, so he reluctantly held up a sword flower, forced the anaconda back, and then went to chop the mandrill.
Suddenly, Chui An's body shook out from the darkness beside him, quickly climbed up his body and entangled him, then opened his huge mouth, swallowed him from head to toe, and then shrank into a ball before exploding with a bang.
The black air surged, the anaconda and the mandrill disappeared, and Yang Li fell into a coma.
In the whistling wind, only two black silk threads were left, one wrapped around Yang Li, and the other wrapped around the fairy sword, dragging it downwards all the way to the bed.
Guan Minghui couldn't suppress the joy on his face. He threw the unconscious Yang Li into the corner and took the sword over.
This sword is indeed good. It is not as good as the top flying swords in Shushan. It cannot cut the fire cloud chain, but it is still rare.
Guan Minghui planned to send it to the lungs of the earth, soak it with black heat, polish it with earth evil spirit, and then try to sacrifice it in the air every day.
In the end, it was refined into the Xuanyin Sect's signature weapon - the Black Evil Sword.
Without the spiritual talisman suppression of Master Changmei, his black silk can extend to a hundred miles away, and can easily penetrate the surface of the earth and directly absorb the moonlight!
As long as he is willing, he can make the mountains and valleys within a hundred miles covered with "black silk"
, swaying in the middle of the night like water plants...
After Yang Li woke up, he didn't understand what happened at first, thinking that he had destroyed the Nine Sun Talisman and caused the demon corpse's alchemy to fail.
At that time, he was still a little happy. Even if he died, at least he could slow down the practice of the demon corpse.
But the more I looked at it, the more something was wrong. The demon corpse was happy every day. He was neither sad or angry nor furious, nor did he kill him.
On the contrary, he had a very good attitude towards him, and injected a burst of Heavenly Mysterious Yin Qi into his Dantian, and taught him a technique on how to refine the black evil energy in his Dantian:
"You helped me accomplish two big things in succession, and this is your reward.
